GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(ds.delinquency_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 逾期期次数 DESC, 逾期本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    l.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(*) AS 该日放款借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown l
GROUP BY l.loan_account_id, l.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id AS customer_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY customer_id ASC;

SELECT sm.staff_id
FROM staff_member sm
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sm.staff_id NOT IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY sm.staff_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_event pe
      WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND pe.is_cash = 1
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = '过期'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
    WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
    ELSE '常态'
  END AS 档位,
  COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 档位
ORDER BY CASE 档位 WHEN '常态' THEN 1 WHEN '临期' THEN 2 WHEN '已到期' THEN 3 END;

SELECT cl.collateral_id, COUNT(*) AS association_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.status = '有效'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY association_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    AVG(cv.valuation_amount) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS 评估笔数
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = '内部'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY AVG(cv.valuation_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    lr.repayment_account_id AS 还款账户编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    cnt.cnt AS 该账户承接借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN (
    SELECT repayment_account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
) cnt ON ld.repayment_account_id = cnt.repayment_account_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        repayment_account_id,
        loan_id,
        disbursed_on,
        disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repayment_account_id ORDER BY disbursed_on, loan_id) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown
    WHERE repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
) lr ON ld.loan_id = lr.loan_id AND lr.rn <= 2
ORDER BY ld.repayment_account_id ASC, ld.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS 累计放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    SUM(ab.ledger_balance - ab.available_balance) AS total_difference
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE ab.ledger_balance > ab.available_balance
  AND (ab.ledger_balance - ab.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = '正常'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT card_id, card_type, issued_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC, card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.payment_mode = '受托支付' THEN l.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_entrusted_payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.payment_mode != '受托支付' THEN l.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_self_payment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.payment_mode = '受托支付' THEN l.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(l.disbursed_amount), 0) AS entrusted_payment_ratio
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.payment_mode = '受托支付' THEN l.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(l.disbursed_amount), 0) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_payment_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 单笔放款金额,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 90
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN COALESCE(wps.cumulative_subscription_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS actual_raise_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS planned_raise_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN COALESCE(wps.cumulative_subscription_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completion_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN wealth_product_snapshot wps ON wp.product_id = wps.product_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING completion_rate > 1.2
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'organization'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status != '逾期' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY 逾期借据笔数 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    borrower.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    payee.display_name AS 实际收款人名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.signed_on AS 合同签署日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON l.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE l.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT rs2.loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule rs2
    WHERE rs2.status = '已结清'
)
GROUP BY l.loan_id
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 期末剩余本金,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS 期末逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE l.status = '核销'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.opened_on AS 账户开立日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.account_subtype AS 账户类型,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '储蓄'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = '信用'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
    avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
    (avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate - ca.annual_interest_rate) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca2.institution_id,
        ca2.product_family,
        AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_annual_interest_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family
) avg_rate ON ca.institution_id = avg_rate.institution_id 
          AND ca.product_family = avg_rate.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < avg_rate.avg_annual_interest_rate
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE (pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id OR pr.target_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id)
        AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
        AND pr.effective_to IS NULL
  )
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC;

SELECT pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id, rc.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rc ON pr.relation_type = rc.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
  AND pr.source_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
  AND pr.target_party_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT borrower_party_id FROM credit_agreement)
ORDER BY rc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_balance,
    cs.net_capital,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital AS ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id 
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
    AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON pe.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN party payer ON ah_from.party_id = payer.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON pe.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN party payee ON ah_to.party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pe.payment_type = '转账'
  AND pe.status = '成功'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM party_relation pr
      WHERE pr.source_party_id = payer.party_id
        AND pr.target_party_id = payee.party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
        AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pr.effective_to >= pe.business_date)
  )
GROUP BY payer.party_id, payee.party_id, payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = '在售'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    phs.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phs.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.investment_path = '多层中介'
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lb.principal_balance AS 账面本金余额,
    MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) AS 最长逾期天数
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON l.loan_id = lb.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d ON l.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND d.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY l.loan_id, lb.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(d.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 最长逾期天数 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS involved_institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count_with_credit
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE egm.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY involved_institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.overdue_principal), 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ls.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ls.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS 对外担保合计,
    COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0) AS 自身借款合计,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    sm.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sm.departed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY sm.staff_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
  AND so.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY so.operator_id, p.display_name, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE ld.disbursement_account_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ca.product_family = lpc.product_family
WHERE rs.status = '逾期'
GROUP BY lpc.product_name_zh
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_90_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on > date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_90_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY expired_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS joint_account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY joint_account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT lbs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count,
    SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    SUM(rs.principal_due) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON l.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.due_date < date('now')
  AND rs.paid_on IS NULL
  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY l.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY SUM(rs.principal_due) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS overdue_installment_count,
    SUM(rs.interest_due) AS total_interest_due
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d ON ld.loan_id = d.loan_id
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 0 OR d.interest_overdue_days > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    rs.installment_no,
    rs.principal_due,
    rs.interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON rs.loan_id = l.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = '逾期'
  AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    cs.net_capital AS capital_net,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS disbursement_to_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY disbursement_to_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc 
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = '有效'
    AND gc.effective_to IS NULL
WHERE sa.security_type = '保证担保'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id AS 授信额度编号,
    cf.limit_amount AS 授信限额,
    sc.name_zh AS 额度状态名称
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN status_catalog sc 
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_facility' 
    AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cf.facility_type,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_limit
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY total_limit DESC;

SELECT facility_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS record_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY ld.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY record_count DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = '在售'
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        quartile_group,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE product_id IN (
        SELECT product_id 
        FROM wealth_product 
        WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    )
    GROUP BY quartile_group
)
SELECT 
    quartile_group AS 分组序号,
    product_count AS 产品数量
FROM grouped
WHERE product_count BETWEEN 31 AND 33
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC;

SELECT 
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = '循环授信'
  AND ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    payment_type_catalog.name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(payment_instruction.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction
JOIN payment_type_catalog ON payment_instruction.payment_mode = payment_type_catalog.payment_type
WHERE payment_instruction.status = '待执行'
GROUP BY payment_instruction.payment_mode, payment_type_catalog.name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    itc.name_zh AS instrument_type_name_zh,
    sc.name_zh AS status_name_zh
FROM instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY itc.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS credit_manager_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON ou.org_unit_id = sa.org_unit_id
    AND sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
    AND sa.effective_to IS NULL
WHERE ou.unit_type = 'BRANCH'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY credit_manager_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    ds.principal_overdue_days AS 本金逾期天数,
    ds.overdue_principal AS 逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 0
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS cnt
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON l.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON l.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_name_en = 'Stage 2'
  AND ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / ps.required_amount < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY cnt DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS provision_gap_total
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON p.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY provision_gap_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_subtype, abs.balance
FROM account a
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'SECONDARY'
LEFT JOIN account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE a.status = 'DORMANT'
  AND a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND ah.account_holder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY abs.balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(*) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
  AND p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分层 ASC;

SELECT 
    asset_category_primary,
    COUNT(*) AS asset_count
FROM managed_asset
WHERE is_liability = 0
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND industry_code IN (
      SELECT sector_code 
      FROM industry_sector 
      WHERE risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
  )
GROUP BY asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, asset_category_primary ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector, COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, pp.occupation_code ASC, pp.employment_sector ASC;

SELECT status AS 卡状态, COUNT(*) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = '借记卡'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 卡状态 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE a.account_kind = '贷记卡结算账户'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.status = '成功'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    p.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pc.card_id AS 银行卡编号,
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    p.business_date AS 交易日期,
    p.amount AS 交易金额
FROM payment_event p
JOIN payment_card pc ON p.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY p.amount DESC, p.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
ORDER BY card_count DESC, holder_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_type AS 银行卡类型名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id OR pe.to_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type IN ('贷记卡', '借记卡')
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY pc.card_type
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, 银行卡类型名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    channel AS 交易渠道,
    COUNT(*) AS 交易数量,
    AVG(amount) AS 平均金额
FROM payment_event
WHERE status = '已结算'
  AND is_cash = 0
GROUP BY channel
HAVING AVG(amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY AVG(amount) DESC, channel ASC;

SELECT a.account_id, t.maturity_on, a.status
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < date('now')
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON c.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation DESC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS reference_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS distinct_security_count
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN collateral_link cl ON c.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = '有效'
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY reference_count DESC, c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(disb.total_disbursed, 2) AS 实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) disb ON ca.agreement_id = disb.agreement_id
WHERE gc.guaranteed_amount > disb.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信合同金额,
    COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cc.covered_amount, 0)), 0) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cc.covered_amount, 0)), 0) AS 保障缺口
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        so2.agreement_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(cl2.pledged_amount, 0)) AS covered_amount
    FROM secured_obligation so2
    JOIN security_agreement sa2 ON so2.security_id = sa2.security_id
    JOIN collateral_link cl2 ON sa2.security_id = cl2.security_id
    WHERE so2.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY so2.agreement_id
) cc ON ca.agreement_id = cc.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = '有效'
  AND ca.effective_to IS NULL
  AND ca.contract_amount > COALESCE(cc.covered_amount, 0)
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 拨备不足借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 拨备不足借据笔数 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    l.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    l.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lb.principal_balance AS 贷款余额,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON l.loan_id = lb.loan_id
WHERE lb.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount >= 4
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, l.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(*) AS 多计提笔数,
    SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id,
    c.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN v.valuation_amount END), 2) AS internal_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'external' THEN v.valuation_amount END), 2) AS external_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN v.valuation_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'external' THEN v.valuation_amount END), 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN collateral_valuation v ON c.collateral_id = v.collateral_id
WHERE v.valuation_type IN ('internal', 'external')
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN v.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL 
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'external' THEN v.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'external' THEN v.valuation_amount END) < MAX(CASE WHEN v.valuation_type = 'internal' THEN v.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

SELECT 
    c.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
    c.asset_label AS 资产名称,
    ROUND(latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 最新评估价,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0), 2) AS 累计质押额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) - latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 覆盖缺口
FROM collateral_asset c
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        collateral_id,
        valuation_amount,
        valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    WHERE valued_on = (
        SELECT MAX(valued_on)
        FROM collateral_valuation cv2
        WHERE cv2.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
    )
) latest_val ON c.collateral_id = latest_val.collateral_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON c.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
    AND cl.status = '有效'
    AND cl.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, latest_val.valuation_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) > latest_val.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 覆盖缺口 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_sum.total_loan_amount, 0), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount, 0), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT borrower_party_id, SUM(contract_amount) AS total_loan_amount
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY borrower_party_id
) loan_sum ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_sum.borrower_party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT guarantor_party_id, SUM(guaranteed_amount) AS total_guarantee_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment
    WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND effective_to IS NULL
    GROUP BY guarantor_party_id
) guarantee_sum ON g.guarantor_party_id = guarantee_sum.guarantor_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.effective_to IS NULL
  AND loan_sum.total_loan_amount > 0
  AND guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount > loan_sum.total_loan_amount
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_sum.total_loan_amount, guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount
ORDER BY guarantee_sum.total_guarantee_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证承诺金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc 
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = '有效'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证承诺金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
  AND p.customer_segment IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    egc.name_zh AS 中文敞口组类型名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员去重数量
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egc ON eg.group_type = egc.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, eg.group_type
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 成员去重数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS member_customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, member_customer_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca 
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'organization'
  AND p.status = 'active'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM party_relation pr2 
      WHERE (pr2.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr2.target_party_id = p.party_id)
        AND pr2.relation_type NOT IN ('non-related')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca2 
      WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
  )
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT p.party_id AS 客户编号,
       p.display_name AS 客户名称,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 客户编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) AS source_contract_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS target_contract_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN credit_agreement ca1 ON ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = '有效'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = '有效'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_principal, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_exposure ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_exposure.borrower_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (g.effective_to IS NULL OR g.effective_to >= date('now'))
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_exposure.total_principal
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(loan_exposure.total_principal, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    g.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    g.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = '有效'
  AND g.guarantor_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ld.agreement_id
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
        AND lbs.as_of_date = (
            SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
        )
        AND ca.borrower_party_id = g.guarantor_party_id
  )
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.overdue_principal), 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs 
    ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma 
    ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld 
    ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca 
    ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    AND ca.borrower_party_id = ma.obligor_party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ls 
    ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
    AND ls.overdue_principal > 0
WHERE wp.issuer_institution_id = ca.institution_id
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 0
  AND ma.is_liability = 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantee_method,
    COUNT(*) AS guarantee_contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantee_contract gc
JOIN guaranteed_obligation go ON gc.contract_id = go.guarantee_contract_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON go.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = '有效'
GROUP BY gc.guarantee_method
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sa.status = '有效'
  AND (cl.status = '有效' OR cl.status IS NULL)
  AND (gc.status = '有效' OR gc.status IS NULL)
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
    AND ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE eg.group_type = '关联客户型'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS 倒挂金额合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 0) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN party p ON ma.issuer_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.party_id = (
    SELECT ah.party_id 
    FROM account_holder ah 
    WHERE ah.account_id = ld.loan_account_id 
    LIMIT 1
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  AND wp.issuer_institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    phs.holding_id
ORDER BY 
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_priority_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_sixty_percent_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = '有效'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_sixty_percent_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fs.total_assets), 0), 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs 
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.tier1_capital IS NOT NULL 
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL 
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets != 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets * 1.0 / NULLIF(fs.total_assets, 0), 6) AS net_capital_to_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY net_capital_to_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot fs2
    JOIN institution i2 ON fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i2.institution_id
) total_rev ON 1=1
WHERE fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.originator_institution_id,
    COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM managed_asset ma
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id
ORDER BY mismatch_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS 本金合计
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 本金合计 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.staff_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = '固定雇佣'
  AND so.operator_kind = '柜面'
  AND so.authority_level IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') >= 0
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 30
GROUP BY ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN provision_snapshot p ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party pt ON pt.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = pt.party_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
    COUNT(rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.exception_flag = 1
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.annual_revenue > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / MAX(fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_percentage
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
  AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_percentage DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS instruction_count
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY instruction_count DESC, pi.payment_mode ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(pm.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    SUM(pm.amount_value) AS abnormal_amount,
    cs.net_capital,
    fs.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(pm.amount_value) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital * 100, 4) AS abnormal_to_net_capital_pct
FROM institution i
JOIN prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 pm ON i.institution_id = pm.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE pm.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital, fs.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(pm.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY abnormal_to_net_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount - COALESCE(ps.recognized_amount, 0)), 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
    AND r.status_code = '逾期未完成'
WHERE ld.loan_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (ps.recognized_amount IS NULL OR ps.recognized_amount < ld.disbursed_amount)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 拨备缺口金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS credit_facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.amount_value), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gc.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gc ON i.institution_id = gc.institution_id
WHERE gc.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(gc.record_id) >= 5
ORDER BY governance_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rtr.subject_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rtr.event_code) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rtr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p ON rtr.subject_id = p.party_id
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.event_code = 'OPERATIONAL_RISK' AND o.exception_flag = 1 THEN o.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(o.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 o ON i.institution_id = o.institution_id AND o.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(o.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY operational_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS 在售产品数,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS 实际募集合计,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS 产品行为记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS 平均比值
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id
WHERE wp.status = '在售'
  AND pce.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 实际募集合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ma.status = '有效' THEN ma.asset_id END) AS valid_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ma.status = '有效' AND ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN ma.issued_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS exception_amount
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.status = '有效'
GROUP BY ma.originator_institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN ma.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
